text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is not focused on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. Instead, it presents a trait-based ecological risk assessment framework quantifying the impact of past and potential future agricultural land-use changes on farmland bird populations at a pan-European scale. It does not implement explicit national-scale spatial LULC modeling, nor does it produce mapped LULC projections or quantitative spatial predictions of land-use change. The focus is ecological/biodiversity impact assessment using existing agricultural statistics and bird population trends, without spatially explicit LULC future scenario mapping or accuracy metrics. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction studies and does not meet the requirements for national-scale spatial implementation or spatial modeling outputs.)
